app.title: Score67
landing.title: Your game. Your scoreboard.
landing.body: Control from your phone. Show it on stream. No account needed.
create.note: Starts with Home vs Guest. Tap a team to change its name and color. The scoreboard receives an automatic timestamp.
pin.note: This PIN is shown only now. Other devices can control using the link and PIN. Keep both safe. Email recovery will follow later.
offline: Offline · points and fouls are saved and sent automatically
uncertain: No response received. Checking again will not count the action twice.
finish.confirm: Finish this match? You can undo this in the log.
name: Team name
new.confirm: Start a new Home vs Guest match? The previous match stays saved.
pin.rotate.confirm: The old PIN will stop working. Existing authorized devices retain access.
obs.note: Add to OBS as a 1920 × 1080 browser source. The background is transparent.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.state_changed: Another device changed the match. The state was refreshed. Check and repeat your action.
error.admin_required: This device has no access. Please enter the PIN.
error.pin_locked: Too many incorrect PINs. Please wait 15 minutes.
error.rate_limited: Up to 5 new scoreboards per hour. Please try later.
error.invalid_transition: This action is not available in the current phase.
error.undo_changed: The last event has changed. Please check again.
error.finish_first: Please finish the current match first.
error.clock_value_required: Please enter the elapsed time in this period.
dashboard.device: These are the scoreboards this device can control. On another device, sign in once using the link and PIN.
dashboard.empty: No scoreboards on this device yet. Create one, or open an existing control link and enter its PIN.
app.local: Saved on this device. Existing games are not changed.
games.empty: No games yet. You can create a new game.
time.local: Dates and times use this device’s time zone.
game.archive.confirm: Archive this game? You can restore it later. If its result is currently on stream, it will be hidden.
game.delete.confirm: Delete this game? It will disappear from your dashboard and public displays. You cannot undo this here.
error.schedule_future: Please choose a future date and time.
error.restore_first: Please restore this game from the archive first.
error.red_cards_zero: There are no red cards to remove.
live.title: Live games
live.description: All games in progress, including breaks. Open a live game for the full scoreboard.
live.empty: No games are running right now. Games appear here automatically after kick-off.
live.offline: Connection lost. Scores shown may be out of date. Reconnecting automatically.
location.title: Venue
location.help: Tap the map, drag the pin or use your current location.
location.import: Coordinates or Google Maps link containing coordinates
location.label: Venue name (optional)
location.private_note: When off, only controllers can see the location. It is hidden from spectators, live listings and OBS.
location.map_error: Map tiles could not load. Coordinates and geolocation still work.
location.geo_error: Location unavailable or permission denied. Check permissions or choose a point on the map.
location.import_error: Enter latitude, longitude (e.g. 53.55, 9.99) or a full Maps link containing the selected place. For short links or map views, open Google Maps and copy the coordinates.
squad.note: For this game only. Number or name is enough. Squad and player assignments are public.
player.name: Name
yellow.note: For a second-yellow dismissal, record the red card separately.
error.invalid_squad: Use a number (0–999), a name (up to 60 characters), or both. Up to 40 players per team.
error.duplicate_player: Each shirt number must be unique within the team.
error.player_not_found: This player is no longer in this team’s squad. Please choose again.
error.event_unavailable: This event was changed or corrected. Please refresh.
error.yellow_cards_zero: There are no yellow cards to remove.
player.recorded: Already recorded. Player selection is optional; closing leaves the event unchanged.
basketball.pilot: Basketball pilot: choose foul counting; timeouts show total used. Shot clock and timeout quotas are not included yet.
foul.number_error: Enter a shirt number from 0 to 999.
foul.note: Personal fouls stay in the controls. In “both” mode one entry also counts as a team foul. Stop the clock separately; five fouls do not automatically block a player.
error.clock_running: Stop the clock before adding points.
error.player_number_required: Select a squad player with a shirt number.
basketball.scoring_note: Tap +1, +2 or +3 in the scorer’s row. The clock keeps running.
basketball.squad_note: Add shirt numbers and optional names. Points can always be assigned to the unknown player or a squad player.
stats.title: Live player statistics
stats.help: Adjust stats directly with +/−. For points, −1/−2/−3 removes the latest matching basket for that player. Swipe sideways for all columns.
stats.enable_pf: Select Personal or Both in the foul mode above to add PF.
stats.reb.description: Recovering the ball after a missed shot.
stats.ast.description: A pass that directly leads to a teammate scoring a basket.
stats.stl.description: Defensively taking the ball away from an opposing player.
stats.blk.description: Defensively deflecting an opponent’s shot attempt.
stats.to.description: Losing possession through a mistake or violation.
stats.pf.description: Personal fouls committed by a player.
basketball.rotate: The scoring screen works in landscape only. Turn your phone sideways (switch off the rotation lock if needed).
game.delete.running.confirm: Delete this running game? It will immediately disappear from live displays and the dashboard. This cannot be undone here.
dashboard.empty_boards.note: No games here. Expand to reuse a scoreboard.
squad.quick_help: Type a number and press Enter for the next player. Tab adds an optional name. Empty rows are ignored.
squad.paste_error: Use one player per line: number, then optional name (e.g. 7 Alex).
sync.offline: Offline: taps are kept on this device and sent automatically when the connection returns
description.hint: e.g. U14 league · matchday 3 · home court
description.private: Only visible to you and other controllers, never to spectators.
